name: Shelene Rhobart
summary: At a Deathguard waystation in Tirisfal, Shelene Rhobart trains leatherworkers for the Forsaken. She supplies cured hides and leather gear for their military and logistical efforts across the blighted lands.

sections.title: Crafting for the Forsaken
sections.body: Southeast of Brill, Shelene Rhobart works at a Deathguard waystation along the main road to the ruins of Lordaeron. Practical crafts still matter in undeath, both for survival and for war. She turns pelts from Tirisfal's prowling beasts into tough hides, armor, straps, and field gear for Forsaken patrols facing the Scourge and Scarlet crusaders.

faq.q: Where can I find Shelene Rhobart?
faq.answer: Find Shelene Rhobart at a small Forsaken post southeast of Brill in Tirisfal Glades, along the road to the Undercity.

faq.q: What role does Shelene Rhobart serve?
faq.answer: Shelene Rhobart trains leatherworkers to cure pelts, stitch garments, and assemble protective leather gear for the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why does she need beast hides?
faq.answer: The Forsaken use animal hides to patch their injured bodies because undead skin does not heal. Shelene's supplies are running low, and she needs duskbat wing membranes, darkhound hides, and Vile Fin murloc skin. Different thicknesses suit different parts of the body.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see how practical crafts help outfit local defenders amid Tirisfal's decay and desolation.
